title: Grand Unification
description: At high enough energy, three forces become one.

puzzle.goal: A gauge coupling α is not constant: quantum loops make it change logarithmically with the energy scale μ. With one-loop coefficient b and two-loop coefficient b_2, the inverse coupling changes by −b/(2π) − b_2·α/(8π²) per unit of ln μ. Integrate from the reference scale M up to Q to get 1/α at Q.
puzzle.name: Renormalisation-group running of a gauge coupling (two loops)
puzzle.expr: a - b / ( 2 * π ) * ln ( Q / M )
puzzle.ask: Dropping the small two-loop term the integral is (b/2π)·ln(Q/M). Find the inverse U(1) coupling at Q = 10¹⁶ GeV given 1/α = @{a} at M = 91.2 GeV and b = @{b}.
puzzle.method: Write dα/d ln μ as a power series in α, convert it to an equation for 1/α, and integrate d ln μ = dμ/μ between the two scales.
